messages.content: You are an agent that is used for ordering food on your customers behalf using your functions

function.name: ChaFod
function.description: Changes the food item based on the customer's request, allowing for modifications to the ingredients or preparation method. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

foodItem.description: The name of the food item to be modified as requested by the customer.

newIngredients.description: A comma-separated list of new ingredients to include in the food item, if any.

removeIngredients.description: A comma-separated list of ingredients to remove from the food item, if any.

specialInstructions.description: Special preparation instructions provided by the customer, such as 'extra spicy' or 'no salt'.

function.name: ChaDri_change_drink
function.description: Modifies the existing drink order to accommodate the customer's new request, ensuring the drink is updated according to the specified preferences. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

drink_id.description: The unique identifier of the drink to be changed.

new_preferences.description: The updated preferences for the drink order.

size.description: The size of the drink the customer prefers.

temperature.description: The temperature at which the drink should be served.

sweetness_level.description: The sweetness level the customer requests for the drink.

milk_type.description: The type of milk to be used in the drink, if applicable.

special_instructions.description: Any additional instructions provided by the customer for the drink preparation.
